results.title: 2024-25 AFC Champions League Elite/League Stage/West Asia
results.content: 1. outline ; This is the West Asia region for the Round of 24 league stage of the 2024-25 AFC Champions League Elite . There is no separate group formation, and 12 clubs from each region play a total of 8 games (4 home games and 4 away games) through a lottery.[1] This is a measure to prevent teams from the same country from competing against each other.
